name: WhatsApp WPP Bridge (mcp-servers)
description: Injects WPPConnect wa-js into WhatsApp Web and boots it AFTER WhatsApp's modules register (fix for WA Web >= 2.3000 / wa-js#3419). Talks to the local mcp-servers `whatsapp` connector across the isolated world via shared-DOM attributes, using a MutationObserver relay so it works fully in the BACKGROUND (no window focus needed). Local/personal use only.
